zones.title: CASE case
zones.body: Create at entry with the mandatory fields and the CASE booking prerequisites, update with the handover context, delegate to XCCC for a callback, close at the end. ScrubFreeText masks e-mail, phone, VIN and postcode in the free-text fields. Standard CRM case REST behind the mock.

panels.title: AR-15 CASE case
panels.body: One case per call, created at entry with the mandatory fields and the booking prerequisites of the CASE case data (2026-10-23): country, account, asset (CVR), VIN or FIN, plate, mileage, assigned dealer, status In Progress, type, topic, reason and the primary contact. Updated with the context before a handover, delegated to XCCC for a retailer callback, closed at the end. ScrubFreeText masks e-mail addresses, phone numbers, VINs and postcodes in the free-text fields (CAC rule: never personal data in free text). A standard REST API behind the mock.
